import_provenance.original_statement: Maintain an undirected graph under edge insertions and deletions so that queries ask whether two vertices remain connected after any one edge failure. Can both updates and queries have deterministic polylogarithmic worst-case time?
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Deterministic polylogarithmic amortized bounds are known; requiring worst-case update bounds is essential. This is a strengthening of Italiano’s dynamic connectivity program.
